data.gender_notes: Nimrata is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Nimrata is a name derived from the Sanskrit language, which means 'Goddess of Death'. In Hindu mythology, this name is associated with Yama, the god of death. Nimrata is believed to be a powerful and fearsome deity, who is often invoked during rituals and ceremonies to ensure a peaceful transition of the soul from this world to the next.
data.etymology: Nimrata belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess of Death.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nimrata total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
